I counted 11 salt crates on the lower shelf.
The inventory sheet lists 32 flour sacks.
Three empty carts are parked outside.

main_story.headline: Region 29 Turns Its Attention to Storehouse Supplies
main_story.lede: A short exchange between Petra and Quill focused on counting and confirming goods at the western storehouse.
main_story.body:
Residents of Region 29 spent part of the day conducting a quiet check on the western storehouse. Petra opened the count by reporting 32 flour sacks on the premises, then returned a minute later to confirm the figure against the *inventory sheet*. Quill added to the tally with 11 salt crates observed on the lower shelf, and separately noted three empty carts parked outside the structure.

The check concluded with a practical observation from Petra that the lower shelf was dry, a minor but useful piece of information for ongoing storage concerns. The brevity of the exchange suggested routine verification rather than any concern, with the two counts aligning and transport apparently ready for use.
